en.headline: CFS urges public not to consume two Olitalia olive oil products
en.dek: The Centre for Food Safety said the Italian pomace olive oils may contain mineral oil hydrocarbons after a Belgian alert; the local distributor has stopped sales and begun a recall.
body: The Centre for Food Safety advised the public not to consume two bottles of Olitalia Pomace Olive Oil, in 1-litre and 5-litre sizes, after detecting a possible presence of mineral oil hydrocarbons.

The centre said it learned through its food incident surveillance system of a notice from the Belgian Federal Agency for the Safety of the Food Chain. The agency reported that the products contained mineral oil aromatic hydrocarbons exceeding local standards and that a recall was under way in Belgium.

Preliminary inquiries showed a local distributor, Yee Sang Trading Company Limited, had supplied the products in Hong Kong. As a precautionary measure the distributor had stopped selling the items, removed them from shelves and started a recall. Members of the public may contact the distributor during office hours on 2293 9398 for return arrangements.

The centre said it had contacted the Belgian authorities and would continue to follow up. Under Hong Kong’s Mineral Oil in Food Regulations, food containing mineral oil may not be sold for human consumption except in limited circumstances related to processing lubricants.

zh.headline: 食安中心籲勿食用兩款Olitalia橄欖油 或含礦物油
zh.dek: 中心指意大利品牌兩款果渣橄欖油可能含芳香族碳氫化合物，分銷商已停售下架並展開回收。
body: 食物安全中心呼籲市民不要食用品牌Olitalia的1公升及5公升瓶裝Pomace Olive Oil果渣橄欖油，指產品可能含有礦物油（芳香族碳氫化合物）。
中心透過食物事故監察系統得悉比利時聯邦食物鏈安全署發出通告，指相關產品被檢出礦物油含量超出當地標準，當地正進行回收。
初步調查顯示本地分銷商義生洋行有限公司曾供應有關產品。作為預防措施，分銷商已停售、下架並展開回收。市民可於辦公時間致電2293 9398查詢回收事宜。
中心已聯絡比利時當局，並會繼續跟進。根據《食物內礦物油規例》，除有限度豁免外，任何人不得售賣含礦物油的食品以供人食用。
